classification: Append-only coverage policy v4 adds reviewed Pyth source classification while preserving previous policy versions
receiptImpact: Adds immutable strict-300s.v4 with Pyth as its own reviewed non-derived source group and publishes a matching versioned production trust reference. The three-provider quorum, existing partner policies, activation set, receipt layouts and historical coverage policy artifacts remain unchanged.
activationRule: Coverage v4 is additive and opt-in. Existing v2/v3 policy IDs remain discoverable and reportable. No partner policy, activation mapping, execution permission or receipt admission changes.

compatibilityMatrix.evidence: Partner policy, activation, signing keys, and receipt layouts are unchanged. Coverage v4 is opt-in; consumers must pin the new policy and signer independently.
